entry.title: The Silt Behind
entry.summary:
Author: broken_promises

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 81,273Chapters: 20/?Kudos: 459

Summary: “What the hell are you doing here?” Eddie asks. It sounds like an accusation. “I, uh— I’m sorry,” Buck stammers, scratching the back of his head sheepishly, his eyes inconspicuously darting down to Eddie’s bloodied hands. “Eddie... What happened?” Eddie’s brows twitch. The anger behind his eyes burns hot and heavy. “No, Buck. We’re not doing this. This is literally the worst time for—” He cuts himself off, aggressively pinching the bridge of his nose. “You don’t get to— to insert yourself like this. Not anymore.” Buck’s heart sinks like a stone in his chest. “You chose this, remember?” Eddie spits, the words dripping with bitter finality. As soon as Eddie says that, Buck’s mouth clicks shut. Because he doesn’t remember choosing any of this. Not the icy silences, nor the irritated glances, nor this suffocating loneliness. All he had wished for was to return to his family, not for them to abandon him.   OR: The tsunami is long over. Buck keeps drowning anyway.
